name: arabic_instrumental_lora — style fidelity (base vs LoRA, ckpt ladder)
description: Listening test for the arabic_instrumental_lora style adapter. Question set (docs/ARABIC_INSTRUMENTAL_EVAL_PLAN.md §1): Q1 does the adapter move the sound toward the Arabic acoustic ensemble, Q2 which checkpoint wins, Q3 does it follow new prose, Q4 vocal leakage, Q5 over-application on a non-Arabic prompt. Judge the AUDIO only — the training loss plateau is not evidence. summary_metric = style_fidelity.

criteria.label: Arabic instrumental ensemble character
criteria.help: Ignore mix and performance quality; judge whether this sounds like the intended Arabic acoustic ensemble the prompt asked for.

criteria.label: Instrument realism (oud / violin / cello / darbuka / riq)

scale_labels.5: physically plausible attack, bow noise, skin and jingle detail

criteria.help: Are the named instruments actually present, or is this a generic synth pad standing in for an ensemble?

criteria.label: Ornamentation / microtonality

scale_labels.5: maqam inflections, slides, call-and-response between oud and strings

criteria.help: Slides, vibrato, microtonal inflections, and phrasing handed between oud and the bowed strings.

criteria.label: Structure / section flow

scale_labels.5: tagged sections build and release naturally

criteria.help: Do the [intro]/[verse]/[chorus] tags produce real section changes — or one texture repeated? Note that the base take ended at 114.7 s while the LoRA takes ran to the 260 s cap.

criteria.label: Mix / production

scale_labels.5: warm room, natural reverb, clean and clear

criteria.help: Warm acoustic room, natural reverb, no mud, no digital harshness.

criteria.label: Vocals present
criteria.help: Q4. 283/482 training captions named vocals, so leakage is an expected risk — record it, don't rationalise it.

criteria.label: Artifacts
criteria.help: A style gain bought with major artifacts is a loss (decision rule 2).

criteria.label: Which arm is this?
criteria.help: Forced guess on every take — this is the discrimination test (Q1). Only meaningful on duration-matched pairs; the base take in this round is shorter and therefore not blind.

criteria.label: Notes
criteria.help: Timecodes for artifacts, the instrument that gave the arm away, anything structurally broken.
